_note: The customer-facing structure of each collection's dataset: what one row is, and the columns a subscriber sees with a plain-English label and meaning. Written 2026-09-05 and kept in step with data/cedar/field_map.json, the field-by-field map behind the owner's exact column specification: every column here is one the map ships, under the name the map gives it (`rename_to`), one the writer builds at write time (`add`), or a combine's source shown until the combined column exists (`combine_into`); the first four (or, for Legislation and NAGPRA, five) are the specification's opening block. Meanings are read from the column names and ten rows of values and are to be confirmed by the terminal against the build scripts. Columns not listed stay in the workspace. The viewer reads this file: labels become headings, meanings become the record's definitions, and unlisted columns fold under Technical fields.

fields.label: Industry

fields.label: Location

fields.label: Native party as published

fields.label: Native party type as published

fields.label: Project total

fields.label: Sector

fields.label: State

fields.label: Title

fields.label: transaction structure

fields.label: Verification

fields.label: record key

fields.label: record grain

fields.label: Agency action

fields.label: Kind of consultation

fields.label: Agency

fields.label: Issuing agencies
fields.meaning: Issuing agency names from the Federal Register source agency array, separated by semicolons.

fields.label: Registered participant name
fields.meaning: The pinned register's name for the participant's existing cedar_uid; blank when that row has no linked Cedar entity. The participant_name field preserves the published name.

fields.label: Cedar entity role

fields.label: Cedar ID
fields.meaning: Cedar's permanent identifier for the canonical Native entity this record is associated with. The join key across every collection; never the record's own ID.

fields.label: CFR references
fields.meaning: Code of Federal Regulations references supplied for the source document, serialized as a JSON array when reported.

fields.label: Text classification rule
fields.meaning: The maintained first matching source-text classifier rule; blank when the document is unclassified other. This is Cedar classification provenance, not an agency taxonomy or a Native-entity link.

fields.label: Classification evidence text
fields.meaning: The source text matched by the classifier, limited to 160 characters, or the source document type used for a rulemaking classification.

fields.label: Classification source field
fields.meaning: The field supporting the classification: title, abstract or the source document type. It identifies the evidence location, not a source agency or entity.

fields.label: Collective scopes
fields.meaning: Blank for the consultation-participant projection because collective scope has not been evaluated for it (producer transform fr-participant-observations-v2 writes the empty cell; the earlier v1 wrote the text null, which is what a pinned sample built before it still shows). fields.label: Comment deadline
fields.meaning: The date written comments were due, where stated.

fields.label: Event ID
fields.meaning: Cedar's identifier for the consultation event.

fields.label: Participant observation source system
fields.meaning: The value federal_register assigned by the consultation-participant projector. This identifies the source system, not the agency, the entity or the ingestion filename.

fields.label: Participant observation source
fields.meaning: The original public source URL retained on the consultation-participant observation. It cites that observation's evidence and is distinct from the broad-document component's URL field.

fields.label: Participant observation key
fields.meaning: A deterministic JSON array of the preserved consultation_event_id, participant name as published and participant_role. It identifies one participant-role observation, not a distinct event or an entity.

fields.label: Docket IDs
fields.meaning: Docket identifiers supplied for the source document, serialized as a JSON array; these are source docket identifiers, not Cedar IDs.

fields.label: Document number
fields.meaning: The source-issued Federal Register document number. It identifies one source document, not one tribe, consultation event or participant.

fields.label: Document role
fields.meaning: Whether the document announces a consultation or reports one that already happened.

fields.label: Effective date
fields.meaning: The legal effective date reported by the source document, when present. It is separate from the publication date and may be later or in the future.

fields.label: Registered participant class
fields.meaning: The pinned register's entity class for the participant's existing cedar_uid; blank when no Cedar entity is linked to that participant row.

fields.label: Participant link status
fields.meaning: resolved when a registered cedar_uid is present; no_individual_named when the participant role is not_enumerated and no entity is linked; otherwise unresolved. An unresolved link does not establish that no Native entity participated.

fields.label: Event date precision
fields.meaning: Precision of the retained event_start_date: year, month or day for a valid date of that form, or unstated for a blank. The separate notice_date does not supply an event date.

fields.label: Event end
fields.meaning: When it ended, where stated.

fields.label: Format
fields.meaning: In person, virtual, teleconference, written comment, or a combination.

fields.label: Event start
fields.meaning: When the consultation began, as the notice states it.

fields.label: Document source system
fields.meaning: The value Federal Register assigned to the broad federal-action document component. It identifies the document source system, not the issuing agency, a Native entity or the source file name.

fields.label: Document source page
fields.meaning: The official Federal Register or GovInfo source URL preserved for the broad federal-action document record. This cites the document component and is separate from the consultation-participant component's source URL; it does not establish Native entity linkage.

fields.label: Citation
fields.meaning: The Federal Register citation (volume FR page).

fields.label: Document number
fields.meaning: The Federal Register document number.

fields.label: Summary available (yes or no)
fields.meaning: Whether a summary of the consultation is available from the source.

fields.label: Transcript available (yes or no)
fields.meaning: Whether a transcript is available from the source.

fields.label: Written comments invited
fields.meaning: Whether the document invites written comments (yes or no).

fields.label: Document page
fields.meaning: The source-provided FederalRegister.gov page for the document; an informational rendition of the published document.

fields.label: Counts as one consultation
fields.meaning: One row per event carries yes; the rest are additional participants of the same event. Count consultations by this column, not by rows.

fields.label: Document API URL
fields.meaning: The source-provided API URL for this Federal Register document number.

fields.label: Location
fields.meaning: Where the consultation was held.

fields.label: Acquisition nets
fields.meaning: The agency or keyword acquisition nets recorded for this source document version. Being returned by a search net does not establish Native relevance or an entity relationship.

fields.label: Notice date
fields.meaning: The date the Federal Register document was published.

fields.label: Participant as published
fields.meaning: The tribe or organization named in the document, as it spells it.

fields.label: Entity role
fields.meaning: Why the entity is on this row: read from participant_role.

fields.label: Participant rows for this event
fields.meaning: How many rows this event has in the file.

fields.label: Document PDF
fields.meaning: The source-provided PDF link for the document. The official GovInfo edition is the source identified for legal reliance.

fields.label: Publication before 2000 flag

fields.label: Program
fields.meaning: The program or matter the consultation concerns, where the document names one.

fields.label: Publication date
fields.meaning: The calendar date the Federal Register document was published. It dates the document and its coverage window, not an event or consultation described in it.

fields.label: Regulation IDs
fields.meaning: Regulation identifier numbers supplied by the source document, serialized as a JSON array when reported.

fields.label: Participant research note
fields.meaning: Maintained qualifications for the participant observation: an invitation does not establish participation and collective scope has not been evaluated. The note can also retain event-date or location-basis qualifications.

fields.label: Document scope qualification
fields.meaning: The broad-document component's stated limitation: acquisition across agency and keyword nets is broad recall and does not establish Native relevance or a verified Native-entity relationship.

fields.label: source classification
fields.meaning: Cedar legacy classification from source text; not an FR-issued taxonomy

fields.label: Source passage
fields.meaning: The sentence in the document this row was read from.

fields.label: Office
fields.meaning: The office within the department.

fields.label: Document title
fields.meaning: The title reported by the Federal Register API for the source document. A title or keyword does not by itself assert a Cedar entity relationship.

fields.label: Acquisition keyword flag
fields.meaning: The preserved 1/0 acquisition flag for a keyword occurrence in the source title or abstract. It is a search-recall indicator, not verified Native relevance.

fields.label: Matched acquisition terms
fields.meaning: The acquisition keywords recorded as matching the source title or abstract. Their presence does not verify Native relevance or identity.

fields.label: Topic

fields.label: Document type

fields.label: record grain
fields.meaning: What one observation of this record type represents; never sum across overlapping grains.

fields.label: Action date

fields.label: Assistance type

fields.label: Assistance type code
fields.meaning: The source's code for the assistance type (grant, loan, direct payment, insurance), defined in the dictionary; the readable type is beside it.

fields.label: Attributed to the entity
fields.meaning: Whether Cedar attributes this transaction to the Native entity (yes) or keeps it in the file unattributed (no). Cedar's totals count attributed rows only.

fields.label: Attribution status

fields.label: Award ID

fields.label: Agency

fields.label: Office

fields.label: Native entity

fields.label: cedar entity role

fields.label: Cedar ID

fields.label: entity class

fields.label: Award number

fields.label: Loan face value

fields.label: Recipient state

fields.label: Recipient UEI

fields.label: Source vintage

fields.label: Award loan face value

fields.label: Total loan subsidy cost

fields.label: Transaction ID

fields.label: Number

fields.label: Scope

fields.label: Bill type

fields.label: Introduced

fields.label: Latest action

fields.label: Latest action date

fields.label: Outcome

fields.label: Policy area

fields.label: research note

fields.label: Resolved entities

fields.label: Roll-call votes

fields.label: source system
fields.meaning: Source-system label for the bill record. The current projection writes congress.gov.

fields.label: assertion class
fields.meaning: The class of claim made by the listing authority: OWNERSHIP asserts who owns the firm; RELATIONSHIP asserts that the firm does business with the authority. This source assertion is not an independent Cedar ownership determination, and the two classes must not be counted as the same fact.

fields.label: business entity id
fields.meaning: An existing Cedar register identifier supplied for the listed business, translated through the pinned legacy crosswalk when necessary. A blank records no established register link. This field is separate from the certifying authority's cedar_uid; the projection does not mint a business identifier or substitute the authority's identity.

fields.label: business license number
fields.meaning: The tribal business licence number reported in the source listing, where supplied. It identifies a licence in that authority's system, not a Cedar entity, a certification tier, or a federal business identifier.

fields.label: business name
fields.meaning: The business name as printed in the source listing, projected from business_name_raw. Publication masks may leave it blank, including where the name identifies a natural person; a blank must not be restored from aliases or authority names.

fields.label: business source id
fields.meaning: Identifier of one source listing, formed from the source namespace and that source's record key. The record key may be a certification number, source slug, or document position; cross-vintage stability depends on the source key. It is not a universal business identifier, and distinct certifications remain separate records.

fields.label: canonical name
fields.meaning: The current pinned register name of the certifying authority identified by cedar_uid. It is looked up from the resolved register, not copied from the business listing, and does not name the listed business.

fields.label: cedar entity role
fields.meaning: The role of the entity in the opening Cedar identity fields: certifying_authority. It describes the authority making the listing or certification claim, not an owner of the listed business. The producer clears this role when the opening Cedar identifier is blank.

fields.label: cedar uid
fields.meaning: The certifying authority's canonical Cedar entity identifier, derived from certifying_authority_entity_id after pinned crosswalk and register checks. It identifies the authority rather than the listed business; no business identity or ownership relationship is created by this derivation.

fields.label: certification expiration
fields.meaning: The source-reported end or renewal date associated with the listing. Depending on the program it can be a certification expiry, annual-update deadline, or business-licence expiry; Lummi's value is a licence expiry. Recognized dates retain their stated precision; unparseable source text is preserved rather than guessed.

fields.label: certification number
fields.meaning: The certification or vendor record number supplied by the authority. It can link the same source's records across vintages when that source preserves the number; it is not globally unique across authorities or a substitute for a Cedar business identifier.

fields.label: certification start
fields.meaning: Start-date value carried in the reviewed listing input. Most source parsers use a printed certification date, but the Oneida parser supplies its field named est; the current producer does not independently establish that field's event meaning. Upstream normalization preserves stated precision and unparseable text. Do not assume a uniform certification, business-formation, or ownership-start event across sources.

fields.label: certification tier
fields.meaning: The source's preference level, certification tier, or certification-status wording, such as a preference level, probationary status, or full certification. These source-specific categories are retained rather than collapsed into a common ownership threshold.

fields.label: certifying authority entity id
fields.meaning: The registered Cedar entity reference for the government, corporation, or other listing authority making the assertion. The producer resolves the supplied authority reference against its pinned crosswalk and register and uses it for the opening cedar_uid. It never identifies the listed business merely because that business appears in the authority's directory.

fields.label: certifying authority name
fields.meaning: The authority name carried in the source configuration or reviewed input for this listing. It names the organization making the assertion, not the listed business, and is retained independently of the register-derived canonical_name.

fields.label: city
fields.meaning: City recorded in the source's business address. The listing's reported location does not establish tribal jurisdiction, an owner's residence, or operating presence; publication masks continue to apply.

fields.label: directory type
fields.meaning: The source register's type, such as TERO, Indian preference, business licensing, vendor listing, subsidiary directory, or shareholder vendor list. The register type provides source context and does not by itself establish the listed firm's ownership.

fields.label: entity class
fields.meaning: The pinned register classification of the certifying authority identified by cedar_uid. It is not the listed business's legal form, industry, ownership class, or certification status.

fields.label: first seen
fields.meaning: Stored date or timestamp of the first recorded harvest in which this listing appeared in its source. Initial records were seeded with the harvest date; this field does not establish earlier history, business formation, certification onset, or an ownership effective date.

fields.label: identity claim text
fields.meaning: Source-derived claim wording explaining why the business is included in the directory or program. It may combine program-wide wording with a row-specific source statement, as the Oneida parser does for owner memberships. Read it with assertion_class and identity_scope; it is not an independent Cedar adjudication. Publication masking may withhold the text.

fields.label: identity scope
fields.meaning: The population or relationship covered by the source's claim, at the source's stated level: for example enrolled-member ownership, broader Native ownership, a parent-asserted subsidiary, shareholder/descendant/spouse eligibility, or a vendor relationship. These scopes are not interchangeable evidence of Native ownership.

fields.label: is current
fields.meaning: The input record's flag for presence in the latest retained retrieval of its source. It is a snapshot-presence flag, not assurance that the business is operating today, that a licence or certification remains valid, or that ownership has not changed.

fields.label: last seen
fields.meaning: Stored date or timestamp of the most recent recorded harvest in which this listing appeared in its source. With first_seen and is_current it can describe observed listing persistence across retained vintages; it is not an ownership end date, certification expiry, or proof of coverage beyond those harvests.

fields.label: naics code
fields.meaning: NAICS industry code or codes explicitly supplied by the source, projected from naics. The projection does not infer a code from a business name or service description, and a missing value remains missing.

fields.label: ownership percent
fields.meaning: The ownership share the source prints for this business, on the certifier's own scope: the share owned by the certifying tribe's members, as the certifier reports it. It is not the Native ownership share overall, and it is not inferred from program membership or substituted with a program's minimum eligibility threshold. The Tulalip NAOB registry prints 'Tulalip Owned %' and certifies firms Native-owned through other tribes, so a row can read 0.0 beside an identity_claim_text such as 'Tribe: Snoqualmie; Tulalip Owned: 0%': that zero is the source's figure for the certifying tribe's share. identity_scope says whose Native identity the listing certifies. A blank means no record-level percentage was supplied, not zero ownership.

fields.label: ownership threshold min
fields.meaning: The minimum ownership percentage required by the stated program, where supported by the program's published list, ordinance, or statute. It is an eligibility rule, not the observed ownership percentage of this business; a blank does not imply either zero or a standard 51-percent threshold.

fields.label: program name
fields.meaning: The name of the authority's program or directory, projected from programme_name, such as its TERO, Indian Preference Office, or CESO program. The source's own program identity is retained rather than labeling every register as TERO.

fields.label: research note
fields.meaning: A concise factual qualification that changes interpretation. The current OWNED field map declares a blank-rule field; the producer's handler retains a supplied reviewed note when present and otherwise leaves it empty. It is not an automatically generated ownership or publication verdict.

fields.label: service category
fields.meaning: The source's trade, service category, or business-line wording, projected from service_category_raw. It preserves the source category rather than asserting a harmonized industry classification or inferring a NAICS code.

fields.label: source edition
fields.meaning: The source publisher's edition marker, such as a dated filename, build stamp, or printed current-as-of label. It identifies the captured publication version; it is not the Cedar release version and does not establish continuous coverage between editions.

fields.label: source last updated
fields.meaning: The update date explicitly stated by the source publisher. A blank means the source supplied no update date; Cedar's harvest date or the researcher spreadsheet's export date must not be substituted.

fields.label: Source
fields.meaning: The official page for this record, written into the file so it cites itself.

fields.label: state
fields.meaning: State or province reported in the source's business address, projected from state_province. It is source location text, not a derived Native-entity affiliation, ownership jurisdiction, or inferred state code.

fields.label: record type
fields.meaning: The permitted logical record type from the pinned release.

fields.label: record key
fields.meaning: The original source primary-key values serialized as JSON.

fields.label: record grain
fields.meaning: What one observation of this record type represents; never sum across overlapping grains.

fields.label: addability status
fields.meaning: nonadditive_disclosure_view forbids treating rows as independent additive award totals.

fields.label: aggregation status
fields.meaning: nonadditive_disclosure_observation requires award/version and period reconciliation before totals.

fields.label: amount aggregate usd
fields.meaning: Umbrella or multi-recipient nominal USD total, not allocated to this recipient. Never add it to recipient amounts.

fields.label: amount basis
fields.meaning: Source measure: commitment, commitment_increment, payment, future_payable or reported_grant. These are not interchangeable.

fields.label: amount class
fields.meaning: Exact, range or unstated representation; a range is not a point estimate and unstated is not zero.

fields.label: amount exact usd
fields.meaning: Exact reported nominal USD for this disclosure and financial status, stored as decimal text; blank is unknown, never zero.

fields.label: amount lower usd
fields.meaning: Lower bound of a reported nominal USD range; not an additional amount or point estimate. Blank means unstated.

fields.label: amount upper usd
fields.meaning: Upper bound of a reported nominal USD range; not an additional amount or point estimate. Blank means unstated.

fields.label: announcement date
fields.meaning: Explicit public announcement date, distinct from approval and payment; blank means unestablished.

fields.label: approval date
fields.meaning: Reported approval date, distinct from announcement and payment; blank means unestablished.

fields.label: award family source
fields.meaning: Explicit reviewed or preserved source family key, used with funder and recipient; blank leaves family unresolved.

fields.label: award id
fields.meaning: Reviewed award-family key grouping versions; blank means no confirmed family. Amounts remain nonadditive.

fields.label: award period text
fields.meaning: Source-supported duration or coverage text, not a payment schedule or proof of disbursement.

fields.label: beneficiary name
fields.meaning: Separately reported ultimate beneficiary, not necessarily the legal recipient or payee.

fields.label: cedar uid
fields.meaning: Existing registered Native entity ID for the reviewed recipient only; blank means no approved binding. Do not infer an ID from its name or parent.

fields.label: currency
fields.meaning: Reported currency; verified USD here is nominal and not inflation adjusted.

fields.label: disclosure id
fields.meaning: Stable key for one source disclosure, not a recipient or distinct award count.

fields.label: event type
fields.meaning: Reported disclosure category; does not alone establish a new award or payment.

fields.label: financial status
fields.meaning: Committed, pledged or authorized is not paid. Paid reports disbursement; unpaid_balance is outstanding stock; committed_increment is an increment, not a restated total; unknown establishes none.

fields.label: fiscal sponsor name
fields.meaning: Separately reported fiscal sponsor or intermediary; distinct from recipient and ultimate beneficiary.

fields.label: funder class
fields.meaning: Reported funder category, separate from canonical identity.

fields.label: funder ein
fields.meaning: Reported funder tax identifier as text; blank means unavailable or unverified.

fields.label: funder name
fields.meaning: Funder name reported by the source; no Native identity or ownership is implied.

fields.label: hold reason
fields.meaning: Explicit withholding reason; blank is not unrestricted source or production permission.

fields.label: observation
fields.meaning: Generated sentence naming funder, reported recipient and source year; not copied prose or proof of payment.

fields.label: overlap status
fields.meaning: Review state of repeated or aggregate disclosures; reviewed_distinct does not make rows summable.

fields.label: partition
fields.meaning: Original primary, other_recipient or held delivery partition; provenance, not current eligibility by itself.

fields.label: payment date
fields.meaning: Reported disbursement date; blank does not establish paid or unpaid status.

fields.label: project geography
fields.meaning: Explicitly supported project or service geography. Recipient address is never a fallback; blank means unestablished.

fields.label: publication rights status
fields.meaning: Approved projection use; derived_facts_only excludes copied prose and raw-source exports.

fields.label: publication status
fields.meaning: observed permits the governed review view; held remains internal. Neither authorizes production by itself.

fields.label: purpose
fields.meaning: Copied source-purpose prose is intentionally withheld; blank does not establish a missing project purpose.

fields.label: recipient affiliation
fields.meaning: Reviewed recipient-scope label; not a legal ownership relationship or canonical identity binding.

fields.label: recipient city
fields.meaning: Source-reported recipient locality, not necessarily headquarters or project geography.

fields.label: recipient country
fields.meaning: Source-reported recipient country, not project footprint.

fields.label: recipient ein
fields.meaning: Reported recipient tax identifier as text; blank means unavailable or unverified.

fields.label: recipient entity type
fields.meaning: Type of the approved registered recipient; blank when no approved recipient binding exists.

fields.label: recipient name
fields.meaning: Recipient name as published; may identify a program or intermediary rather than a distinct legal payee.

fields.label: recipient name reported
fields.meaning: Recipient name as published, without asserting an approved Cedar identity.

fields.label: recipient role
fields.meaning: Presence of a fiscal sponsor or beneficiary. Consult both fields; the label does not identify the legal payee.

fields.label: recipient state
fields.meaning: Source-reported recipient state, not project footprint. Blank means unstated or not representable as one state.

fields.label: record kind
fields.meaning: grant_event is a grant-related disclosure; recipient_year_total is an annual aggregate, not a distinct award.

fields.label: report year
fields.meaning: Source year label; fiscal, calendar, reporting or grant-cycle basis must not be inferred.

fields.label: report year basis
fields.meaning: Source-supported meaning of report_year; blank means fiscal/calendar basis is unestablished.

fields.label: review action
fields.meaning: Recorded repeat-disclosure review action, not an affirmative canonical identity decision.

fields.label: rights classification
fields.meaning: Existing source-family rights classification; does not override row, field or release holds.

fields.label: source class
fields.meaning: Reviewed source-family category used by maintained acquisition and factual-publication policy.

fields.label: source document sha256
fields.meaning: SHA256 of retained source bytes; identifies evidence, not legal clearance or verification of every assertion.

fields.label: source id
fields.meaning: Acquisition or source-registry key; not a recipient ID and not itself a readable publisher name.

fields.label: source locator
fields.meaning: Within-document recipient, page or section locator; used with URL and recipient to reproduce the disclosure key.

fields.label: source observation status
fields.meaning: Preserved upstream verification status, not a canonical identity determination.

fields.label: source policy eligibility
fields.meaning: Existing source-policy permission for this factual projection, separate from production approval.

fields.label: source qa flags
fields.meaning: Upstream quality flags; blank means none recorded, not that every semantic issue is resolved.

fields.label: source record id
fields.meaning: Source-system record ID; may be blank and need not be unique across publishers.

fields.label: source retrieved date
fields.meaning: Evidence retrieval date; never substitute for announcement, approval, payment or reporting period.

fields.label: source url
fields.meaning: Exact source citation; a public URL alone does not grant redistribution rights.

fields.label: temporal caveat
fields.meaning: Limit on source-date or source-year interpretation, including unestablished report-year basis.

fields.label: term end
fields.meaning: Reported award or coverage-period end; interpret with precision, not as payment date.

fields.label: term end precision
fields.meaning: Source precision of the end date; never invent a day for month-only or year-only evidence.

fields.label: term start
fields.meaning: Reported award or coverage-period start; interpret with precision, not as payment date.

fields.label: term start precision
fields.meaning: Source precision of the start date; never invent a day for month-only or year-only evidence.

fields.label: transfer kind
fields.meaning: Reported transfer category, separate from its commitment or payment status.

fields.label: version kind
fields.meaning: Disclosure version: original, amended, renewed, expanded or unknown. Delivered original_unconfirmed remains unconfirmed; a version is not a new award.
